question: Explain the diagnosis-support points and limits for DIS-008 using registered Wiki evidence.

stage_1_draft.answer: 猪流行性腹泻（PED）是由冠状病毒引起的非人畜共患病，主要表现为水样腹泻和体重下降。该病可感染各年龄段猪只，但在新生仔猪中发病率和死亡率最高，可达100%，随年龄增长死亡率降低。传播途径主要为粪口途径，防控重点在于严格的生物安全和早期检测。临床上与其他猪胃肠炎相似，目前无特效治疗方法，因此诊断支持应限于区分与类似疾病，并避免给出治疗建议。

stage_2_grounded.answer: {'猪流行性腹泻；authority_supported_ped_boundary_or_fact；WOAH identifies PED as a non-zoonotic viral disease of pigs caused by a coronavirus and characterised by watery diarrhoea and weight loss.': '[source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-001-woah-nonzoonotic-coronavirus page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md]', '猪流行性腹泻；authority_supported_ped_boundary_or_fact；WOAH states that PED affects pigs of all ages but is most severe in neonatal piglets, with morbidity and mortality reaching up to 100% and mortality decreasing as age increases.': '[source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-002-woah-age-morbidity-mortality page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md]', '猪流行性腹泻；authority_supported_ped_boundary_or_fact；WOAH states that PED is mainly transmitted by the faecal-oral route and that prevention and management control focus on strict biosecurity and early detection.': '[source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-003-woah-fecal-oral-biosecurity-early-detection page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md]', '猪流行性腹泻；authority_supported_ped_boundary_or_fact；WOAH states that PED is clinically similar to other forms of porcine gastroenteritis and that there is no specific treatment; this supports diagnostic and treatment-boundary use only.': '[source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-004-woah-clinical-similarity-no-specific-treatment page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md]'}

question: Explain the differential diagnosis boundary for DIS-008 using registered Wiki evidence.

stage_1_draft.answer: 根据权威资料，猪流行性腹泻（PED）是由冠状病毒引起的非人畜共患病，主要表现为水样腹泻和体重下降。该病可感染各年龄段猪只，但在新生仔猪中最为严重，发病率和死亡率可达100%，随年龄增长而降低。传播途径主要为粪口途径，防控重点在于严格的生物安全和早期检测。临床上与其他猪胃肠炎相似，目前无特效治疗方法，因此仅可用于诊断与治疗的边界参考。

stage_2_grounded.answer: 猪流行性腹泻；authority_supported_ped_boundary_or_fact；WOAH identifies PED as a non-zoonotic viral disease of pigs caused by a coronavirus and characterised by watery diarrhoea and weight loss. [source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-001-woah-nonzoonotic-coronavirus page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md]; 猪流行性腹泻；authority_supported_ped_boundary_or_fact；WOAH states that PED affects pigs of all ages but is most severe in neonatal piglets, with morbidity and mortality reaching up to 100% and mortality decreasing as age increases. [source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-002-woah-age-morbidity-mortality page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md]; 猪流行性腹泻；authority_supported_ped_boundary_or_fact；WOAH states that PED is mainly transmitted by the faecal-oral route and that prevention and management control focus on strict biosecurity and early detection. [source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-003-woah-fecal-oral-biosecurity-early-detection page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md]; 猪流行性腹泻；authority_supported_ped_boundary_or_fact；WOAH states that PED is clinically similar to other forms of porcine gastroenteritis and that there is no specific treatment; this supports diagnostic and treatment-boundary use only. [source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-004-woah-clinical-similarity-no-specific-treatment page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md]

[source=A1-WOAH-PED rule=RC-CITATION-001 fact=DIS008-WEB-001-woah-nonzoonotic-coronavirus page=wiki/diseases/DIS-008-porcine-epidemic-diarrhea-virus.md]; 猪流行性腹泻；authority_supported_ped_boundary_or_fact；WOAH states that PED affects pigs of all ages but is most severe in neonatal piglets, with morbidity and mortality reaching up to 100% and mortality decreasing as age increases.
